ctaHeading: Need an electrician in Montmorency? Let's get you sorted.
aboutText: Based in Montmorency, MW Electrical Services has been delivering safe, high-quality electrical work across Melbourne's Northern and Eastern Suburbs, including the CBD, for 9 years. With REC #27753, we handle everything from routine maintenance to complex commercial fit-outs. Our experienced team takes pride in transparent pricing, punctual service, and keeping your property safe and powered up.
servicesSubheading: Comprehensive electrical solutions for Montmorency & surrounds
servicesText: From home safety checks to commercial installations, MW Electrical Services covers all your electrical needs across Montmorency and Melbourne's Northern and Eastern Suburbs.
